units.api: Creating `const pending = $`echo 123 > ${path}`` (not awaited) must not run the command: right after creation Bun.file(path).text() rejects (file does not exist); then write "456" to path and read back "456" (still untouched); only after `await pending` does the file contain "123\n" (the command runs when awaited and > truncates the "456" written meanwhile).

cases.note: state at the moment the lazy command finally runs: file contains "456"
